answer: A fell running club membership with race finish history works as the gate: finishes logged with one club season after season. Each of 430 aliases needs its own finish histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The relic check runs in the open: 430 fakes pay the full price 430 times, one honest agent pays once, and the garden trail in the ledger makes the beacon cost visible to everyone.
